description: Stores fixed values into four fields of a request structure, makes one library call at offset minus 456, then calls code at a fixed address. It is called from one routine.

name: write_decrementing_global_until_wrap
description: Writes a decrementing word to a global variable on each pass of a loop that runs until the counter wraps around, then returns an all-ones value. The listed colour register touch does not appear in the pseudo-code.

name: fetch_longword_and_shift
description: Reads a longword from the address just below a pointer, stores a word combining the low byte of that longword with a register byte, and returns the longword shifted right by one with the top bit set. It is called from one routine and its listed calls are two unnamed routines.

key: Leander (1991)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr SKR][t +6 DC].adf boot-block load +$600 to $060000 (2560 bytes):0:0110
name: shift_bits_with_refill
description: Loops a counted number of times shifting a bit register right by one, and when the register empties it calls a refill routine to load the next value. It is called from three routines and makes two calls.

name: install_trap_and_copy_longwords
description: Stores the address of a routine in a global variable, raises trap zero, then copies three longwords from a fixed memory area into three fixed low memory locations. It is entered from outside the static flow and makes one call.

name: wait_blitter_then_program_display
description: Waits for the blitter-busy bit in the DMA control read register to clear, then programs the bitplane modulo, control and window registers and the sprite position register, and writes the interrupt enable register. It is called from three routines and makes eight further calls.

name: read_fire_button_and_update
description: Checks a flag byte in a structure and a global state before reading the CIA port that carries the joystick and fire buttons, then makes one call and updates state. It is called from one routine.

name: set_bitplane_pointer_and_decrement
description: Writes the interrupt request register, sets the first bitplane pointer register, calls two routines, and decrements a global counter if it is non-zero. It is entered from outside the static flow.

name: shift_bit_array_left
description: Repeatedly shifts a block of 16-bit words left by one bit through a carry, walking backwards from a fixed address over a counted number of passes. It is called from one routine and makes one call.

name: call_routine_sixteen_times
description: Calls one routine sixteen times in a loop and returns the last result plus one. It is called from one routine and makes one call.

name: init_structure_fields_and_call
description: Writes fixed values into seven fields of a structure, then calls one routine. It is called from one routine and makes one further call.

name: init_structure_fields_and_call
description: Writes fixed values into seven fields of a structure, then calls one routine. It is called from two routines and makes one further call.

name: wait_while_flag_bit_set
description: Polls a byte in a structure until bit 6 is clear, then returns. It is called from one routine.

name: step_byte_toward_target_bounded
description: Copies a byte from one structure into another, then steps a counter field in a structure up or down toward the value of a global byte, stopping at the bound of 18. It makes three calls and is called from one routine.

name: select_table_value_by_type
description: Looks up a type byte in a table indexed by a value, and for type one copies a word from a structure into a global variable, with other types handled separately. It makes one call and is called from three routines.

name: decode_top_bit_byte_stream
description: Reads a byte stream from a pointer, branching on whether each byte has its top bit set, and writes the decoded bytes to a destination. It makes two calls and is called from two routines.

name: copy_bytes_with_strided_pairs
description: Copies seven source bytes at a stride of 60 bytes into a destination at a stride of 92 bytes, writing each byte also at an offset 46 bytes further on. It is called from two routines.

name: copy_bytes_at_strided_offsets
description: Copies seven source bytes at a stride of 60 bytes into a destination at a stride of 46 bytes. It is called from one routine.

name: build_pointer_table_from_strings
description: Walks a series of zero-terminated strings starting at a fixed address and stores a pointer to each string in a table at a fixed address. It is called from one routine.

name: stub_two_instruction_routine
description: A two-instruction routine reached through an address-taken reference from one caller, for which the decompiler produced no pseudo-code. The evidence shows only its size and its caller.

name: boot_allocmem_then_io
description: Boot block that calls the exec library to allocate memory and to run an I/O request through DoIO, filling in fields of the request structure first. If the first library call returns nothing, it returns a fixed all-ones failure value.

name: copy_global_block_to_pointer
description: Copies 256 longwords from a global data area to a destination pointer in a loop. It is reached through an address-taken reference.

name: read_mouse_and_joystick_ports
description: Writes a fixed value to the potentiometer control register, reads the mouse and joystick port movement registers and the right and middle button register, and reads the CIA port with the fire buttons. It tests a state word to choose between two calls and makes two calls in total.

name: store_delta_fields_then_dispatch
description: Computes two byte-sized differences from its two inputs and stores them in structure fields, along with a third field, then calls a handler through a method table slot. It is called from one routine.

name: load_table_entry_then_dispatch
description: Looks up a longword in a global table using two bits of the input word as an index, stores it in a structure field, then stores a further value and calls a handler through a method table slot. It is called from one routine.

name: increment_counter_and_dispatch
description: Increments a global counter and then calls a handler through a method table slot read from a pointer. It is entered from outside the static flow, and no callers are listed.

name: dispatch_pending_interrupt_bits
description: Reads the interrupt request register, masks the pending bits with a fixed value, and calls up to three handlers through function pointers depending on the sign of successive bits. It touches the interrupt enable and request registers.
